_schema: Run 29 session 4 - independent MAIN-AGENT crosscheck (R7) + R16 verdict (is the NARROW ceiling craft-specific or universal?). Strict params-v3 gate baked into verifiers; 0 verifier-OPEN (no optimism to correct).
headline: PIVOT to modern non-craft domains FAILED to escape the ceiling. 0 GAP_OPEN / 8 NARROW / 4 CLOSED. R16 ANSWERED: the NARROW ceiling is STRUCTURAL to the BFS-first-mover method, NOT craft-specific. Modern domains collide HARDER (4 CLOSED vs 0-1 in craft sessions) because they have research funding + commercial vendors.

R16_test_result.question: Do modern non-craft domains yield GAP_OPEN where crafts could not, or is the usable=>has-sibling NARROW ceiling universal?
R16_test_result.answer: UNIVERSAL. The ceiling is a property of the SEARCH METHOD, not the life-axis region. Modern domains also hit NARROW, plus 4 reached CLOSED.
R16_test_result.why_modern_collides_harder: Crafts had a large none-penetration bucket (13-14 concepts) and collided to NARROW via the technique-family sibling. Modern domains have ZERO none-penetration (every niche already has some AI) and collided via BOTH (a) the application already partly built (often a deployed commercial vendor or a published model => CLOSED) AND (b) the technique-family sibling. Modern domains have research $ + vendors, so prior art is denser.
R16_test_result.structural_dilemma_confirmed: The 4-session arc confirms a structural dilemma that caps GAP_OPEN near zero regardless of axis: (1) a USABLE fresh technique is BY DEFINITION already demonstrated on >=1 domain => it has a sibling foothold => any new application is capability-gap NARROW, never method-OPEN; (2) a technique with NO sibling (a genuinely first-of-its-kind application) is, in this 1-6mo window, VAPORWARE (no released code) => fails R13 usability. usable=>has-sibling and no-sibling=>vaporware are mutually exclusive, so GAP_OPEN (usable AND no-sibling) is structurally near-empty. The life-axis cannot rescue it: low-AI regions (crafts) collide via technique-sibling; high-AI regions (modern) collide via application-already-done. 4 sessions, 46 candidates, 0 GAP_OPEN.
